```sql
SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM MIN(p.wikidata)) AS established_year
FROM pois p

                 (SELECT geometry FROM lakes WHERE lake_name ILIKE '%Hickory Grove Riverfront%' LIMIT 1)::geography,
```

```sql
    WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Eddy Lookout Tower%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Sanderson%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%FL%'
```

```sql
SELECT MIN(poi.wikipedia) AS first_opened
FROM pois AS poi
WHERE poi.tourism = 'theme_park'
  AND ST_DWithin(
    poi.geometry::geography,
    (
      SELECT park.geometry::geography
      FROM parks AS park
      WHERE park.park_name ILIKE '%Porte des Morts Park%'
        AND ST_Intersects(
          park.geometry::geography,
          (
            SELECT region.geometry::geography
            FROM regions AS region
            WHERE region.region_name ILIKE '%Ellison Bay%'
              AND region.border_type = 'city'
            LIMIT 1
          )
        )
      LIMIT 1
    ),
    10000
  )
ORDER BY poi.geometry::geography <-> (
  SELECT park.geometry::geography
  FROM parks AS park
  WHERE park.park_name ILIKE '%Porte des Morts Park%'
    AND ST_Intersects(
      park.geometry::geography,
      (
        SELECT region.geometry::geography
        FROM regions AS region
        WHERE region.region_name ILIKE '%Ellison Bay%'
          AND region.border_type = 'city'
        LIMIT 1
      )
    )
  LIMIT 1
);
```

```sql
SELECT DISTINCT ON (p1.id) p1.poi_name, p2.poi_name AS nearest_university
FROM pois p1
CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT p2.poi_name, p2.geometry
    FROM pois p2
```
